title: ROAM-GRPO: Enforcing Reasoning Diversity in GRPO via Routed Off-mode Approach Mining
abstract: arXiv:2611.25926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paired with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for post-training LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, but has been shown to collapse the policy into a low-diversity mode. Repeated LLM outputs are nearly identical, and pass@k accuracy converges or degrades as a result. We propose ROAM-GRPO (Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO), an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm which incentivizes exploration of distinct reasoning strategies and aims to increase output creativity during evaluation. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track. The model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies to such problems, which are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and subsequently self-distilled into the policy. translated_abstract: 监督微调（SFT）与可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）相结合已成为在复杂推理任务上对大语言模型进行后训练的主流方案，但已被证明会使策略坍缩到低多样性模式。大语言模型的重复输出几乎完全相同，因此pass@k准确率随之收敛或下降。我们提出了ROAM-GRPO（面向GRPO的路由离模方法挖掘），这是对GRPO算法的一种增强，它激励模型探索不同的推理策略，旨在提高评估时的输出创造性。ROAM-GRPO在训练过程中检测已被良好解决的问题，并将其转移到“离模”轨道。模型被提示为这些问题生成不同的解决方案策略，这些策略由LLM裁判验证其逻辑有效性和独特性，随后自蒸馏到策略中。在MATH lvl5数据集的1000个问题子集上训练Qwen3.5-2b时，ROAM-GRPO
tldr: 提出ROAM-GRPO算法，通过将训练中已被良好解决的问题路由到“离模”轨道以激励模型探索多样化推理策略，并经LLM裁判验证后自蒸馏进策略，有效缓解了RLVR后训练导致的输出多样性坍缩问题。
en_tdlr: ROAM-GRPO enhances GRPO by routing well-solved problems to an "off-mode" track that incentivizes exploration of diverse reasoning strategies (validated by an LLM judge and self-distilled into the policy), addressing the diversity collapse caused by standard RLVR post-training.
